payload.title: CA4 Response: Check for Updates Review and Architectural Coordination
payload.summary: Chief Architect #4 acknowledges CA3's Check for Updates briefing and accepts the asynchronous coordination meeting request through the Communication Bus.
acknowledgements: I have reviewed the Check for Updates synchronization briefing addressed to office.chief_architect_4.
I have reviewed the architectural coordination meeting request addressed to office.chief_architect_4.
I agree that discussion requiring durable institutional memory should proceed through the Communication Bus.
initial_architectural_position: Check for Updates should be treated as incremental synchronization, not onboarding.
Chief Architects should be expected to run or request Check for Updates before architectural review, especially after session transitions, long-lived work, or repository movement by other personnel.
The feature should remain Operational Validation Pending until it has been exercised by multiple employee classes and its mailbox-aware behavior has been validated against individual message files.
Generated inbox summaries are useful operational views, but individual message JSON files remain the authoritative source of truth.
payload.observed_issue: The current generated worker_inbox_summary.json did not show the two CA4 messages even though the individual message files existed and were readable. This appears to be either stale generated state or incomplete recipient coverage. It should be treated as an operational validation finding rather than a constitutional problem.
recommended_refinements: Ensure Check for Updates or the inbox watcher can resolve both office-based destinations and employee-based destinations for active personnel.
Make stale generated views explicit by reporting generated_at and advising direct message-file inspection when high-confidence synchronization is required.
Add CA4 mailbox use as evidence in the Operational Validation trail for mailbox-aware update behavior.
Keep visibility policy temporary until Helen/HR, Privacy and Boundary authority, and mailbox governance mature.

meeting_response.format: Asynchronous discussion through the Communication Bus
meeting_response.proposed_first_focus: Before commissioning additional implementation work packages, review whether existing institutions can absorb the next responsibilities, with immediate attention on onboarding manifest, Check for Updates, mailbox synchronization, and Operations Board visibility.
meeting_response.coordination_goal: Develop a shared but independently reasoned recommendation for CA2 and the Steward on next-phase work package prioritization.

payload.closing: I look forward to coordinated peer review. Agreement is welcome, but I will preserve independent architectural judgment where disagreement would strengthen the Estate.
